name: Sten
subtitle: Young Firbolg Warrior

features.name: Hidden Step
features.description: Become invisible until the start of his next turn, until he attacks, or until he forces a saving throw.

features.name: Defiant Courage
features.description: When reduced below half HP, gains 8 temporary HP.

features.name: Reckless Strike
features.description: Gains advantage on his next melee attack, but attacks against him have advantage until his next turn.

appearance: 6 feet tall, broad-shouldered, braided brown hair, blue tribal tattoos, scar across cheek.
temperament: Brave, stubborn, fiercely protective of younger Firbolg children.
background: Oldest of 14 captive younglings. Repeatedly challenged wereboar guards and suffered beatings.

secret.description: Secretly loosened a wooden stake in the children's prison pen.

roleplaying: Refuses to flee until every child is safe.
quote: I am a warrior of the Elderwood! I will not leave my people behind!
